subject: Kernel squad seniority mix: proposal for Q3 seat allocation
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Kernel squad seniority mix: proposal for Q3 seat allocation

Folks —

Attached is a compact proposal (kernel_seniority_matrix.xlsx) for the kernel team headcount mix we discussed at last week's staffing sync. TL;DR: two candidate paths for the 3 approved seats in Q3:

Option A (balanced): 1 Senior SWE, 1 Mid SWE, 1 Junior SWE (mix keeps senior coverage for architecture & mentor capacity)
Option B (staff-first): 2 Seniors, 1 Junior (accelerates runtime kernel work for quantization & perf wins)

Key tradeoffs called out in the sheet: ramp time, mentorship load, expected throughput gains in 6 months, and unit-cost delta vs. baseline. I flagged the comp-band guidance from People Ops (offer-comp-band-guidelines.pdf) in the doc.

Asks:
- Quick preference (+1) for A or B by EOD PT so I can route to Finance/People Ops for offer preparation
- If you have an alternative headcount source (pool we can reallocate from), say so here — that can lift the comp impact

If we don't align today, we default to Option A to preserve bench depth.

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Hiring lead, Platform Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: kernel_seniority_matrix.xlsx, offer-comp-band-guidelines.pdf

Subject: Re: Kernel squad seniority mix: proposal for Q3 seat allocation

Priya —

Option B aligns more with the two-quarter roadmap risk (quant/latency milestones). My +1 for B, conditional on guaranteeing a senior will lead the perf work and mentor the mid/junior. If People Ops flags comp delta as material, I'm open to a 1.5/1.5 split (one staff, one senior-ish, one junior) but that is messy.

Quick note inline:
> If we don't align today, we default to Option A to preserve bench depth.

I get the conservatism, but given the outages we saw on longer sequences, having more senior capacity helps reduce on-call churn later.

Karthik
VP, Serving Runtime

I want to flag a cost vector we haven't fully quantified. The staff/senior hires are likely to push comp runrate ~18-22% above the baseline mid-only plan in the attached. Given current budget cadence, Finance will want a concrete cost-delta and a proposed source of funds.

One idea: shift one of the platform SRE seats (slated for Q3 contingency) into the kernel slate and make the SRE request a Q4 priority. That keeps our velocity on critical kernel infra but doesn't grow net headcount in H2. I added a note and link to the Jira ticket where the SRE slate is tracked (JIRA:SUP-345) — see the 'cost-delta-runbook.pdf' attachment for quick numbers.

If we go staff-first (Option B), we should lock the initial offer band to the low-end of the senior band and push a rapid calibration for top performers.

—Marcus
Director, Platform Infrastructure

Thanks for the clear options and the rapid turn. Two operational asks from Finance/People Ops perspective before I can sign off: 1) a one-page delta that shows expected comp run-rate (annualized) for Option A vs B including total offer spend for the 3 hires; 2) proposed source of funds (Marcus' suggestion to reallocate one platform SRE seat is acceptable; please mark which seat and update SUP-345).

CCing Neha for People Ops intake — Neha, please confirm if the bands in the attached PDF are still the ones we should use for low-end offers. If comp delta is >15% we may need Exec approval.

If we get the delta by 5pm PT I can route to Execs for a quick sign-off tonight.

Thanks all — summary and next steps below.

Decision: Exec route is required only if comp delta >15%. Given Marcus' numbers and Karthik's preference, we will proceed with Option B (2 Seniors, 1 Junior) but constrain offers to the low-end of the senior band where possible. This is contingent on the reallocation Marcus suggested: moving one platform SRE seat (SUP-345) into the kernel slate for Q3.

Action items:
- Priya: finalize the comp delta memo (one-pager) and upload as 'cost-delta-runbook.pdf' to the linked Sheet and SUP-345 (due 5pm PT)
- Marcus: mark the SRE seat reallocation in SUP-345 and confirm no downstream infra blockers (due EOD)
- Neha: confirm band guidance for low-end senior offers and start intake for offer letters once memo is posted
- Kimberly: if delta ends up >15% please flag for Exec approval; otherwise route offers via standard People Ops flow

I attached the updated matrix with final markings. Once offers are accepted we'll run paired mentorship plans (senior -> junior) to accelerate onboarding. Thanks for the quick alignment.

Priya Natarajan
Hiring lead, Platform Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: cost-delta-runbook.pdf, kernel_seniority_matrix.xlsx
